paper_title: BabySLM: language-acquisition-friendly benchmark of self-supervised spoken language models
reason: BabySLM은 영어 음성 모델(STELA 등)의 어휘·구문 수준 zero-shot 탐침 벤치마크로, 평가 입력이 Google TTS로 합성한 음성이다. 인벤토리의 modality는 text와 vision만 허용하므로 음성 입력 벤치마크는 어느 쪽에도 맞지 않는다. 논문의 중심은 아동 언어 습득 시뮬레이션과 음성 자기지도 모델 평가라서 범용 LLM 벤치마크 인벤토리의 범위 밖으로 판단한다. 텍스트 기반 LSTM·BabyBERTa 비교는 보조 실험일 뿐이다. 공식 코드(github.com/MarvinLvn/BabySLM)는 확인되지만 modality를 정직하게 기록할 수 없어 행을 제안하지 않는다.

screening.paper_title: BabySLM: language-acquisition-friendly benchmark of self-supervised spoken language models
screening.abstract: Self-supervised techniques for learning speech representations have been shown to develop linguistic competence from exposure to speech without the need for human labels. In order to fully realize the potential of these approaches and further our understanding of how infants learn language, simulations must closely emulate real-life situations by training on developmentally plausible corpora and benchmarking against appropriate test sets. To this end, we propose a language-acquisition-friendly benchmark to probe spoken language models at the lexical and syntactic levels, both of which are compatible with the vocabulary typical of children's language experiences. This paper introduces the benchmark and summarizes a range of experiments showing its usefulness. In addition, we highlight two exciting challenges that need to be addressed for further progress: bridging the gap between text and speech and between clean speech and in-the-wild speech.

votes.reason: 음성 언어모델 벤치마크이나 언어 불명확, LLM 범위 불확실
